who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane EX (builder expression shapes)
what: The lane's check is 'the rows shrink in the next census', but every census after g042737 (g043439 .. g050933) has no `CLASS builder` rows: the runs stop in the front end (g050349 ends 'stopped: a panic (its place is on stderr, above)'; g050933 holds only its header), so no builder row can be counted before or after a fix. Also the subagent had no Grep tool, so read-only searches went through Bash.
cost: the before/after quote is impossible; each fix is proven by its own build-and-run test only
cause: the census binary panics or stops before the build stage, and the census file does not say how far it got in a machine-readable line
whys: the census writes its builder section only at the end; a panic upstream leaves the file without it
class: a progress check that depends on a later stage of a pipeline that an unrelated failure cuts short
prevention: wanted: the census writes a 'STAGE builder: not reached (why)' line, and a lane's brief names the census run its check will read
workaround: quote g042737 as 'before' and say no 'after' exists yet
